cues.text: A dark, angular figure appears, raising a hand among the faithful.
The demon reaches out with jagged claws. The faithful scatter in terror.
A faithful warrior battles the heretic.
The glowing murals decorate the walls of a dark, hexagonal chamber.
Clad in a bulky black suit with a glowing orange faceplate, the figure holds a long staff.
The balcony sits within the windowed bridge of a colossal starship.
Outside in the void, a massive fleet of jagged vessels flanks the great Ark.
Glowing orange thrusters propel the armada forward into the starry expanse.

beats.note: Lines of glowing gold light start tracing a cityscape on a dark surface.
Smoke stacks are drawn, with smoke billowing from them.
The glowing lines pull back, revealing the city is a small etching on a large dark surface.
A glowing diamond shape, a Virtual relic, descends.
The diamond shines light on a hunched, spidery, skeletal figure etched in gold.
The skeletal figure transforms into a tall, upright humanoid figure in a hooded suit, glowing brightly.
The glowing figure stands tall, arms crossed.
A crowd of similar figures appears below the central figure.
The perspective shifts right, revealing a dark figure with an angular head shape amongst the crowd.
This false prophet figure raises a hand, summoning a large, demonic, horned creature.
The demon reaches out to the crowd. People in the crowd start running away in terror.
The false prophet stands on a pedestal, preaching.
The scene shifts to two figures fighting. One with a spear, one with a staff.
The faithful figure strikes down the heretic.
The faithful figure stands victorious, glowing brightly.
The perspective pulls back to reveal all these glowing etchings are on the walls of a dark, hexagonal room.
A real, three-dimensional Vodyani leader in a black suit with a glowing orange faceplate stands on a balcony overlooking the etched walls.
The leader stands tall, holding a long staff. The perspective slowly pulls back.
The balcony is revealed to be part of the bridge of a massive spaceship, looking out into space.
A fleet of similar, smaller, jagged black ships flank the massive Ark.
The fleet flies forward through space, their thrusters glowing orange and leaving trails of light.
Fade to black.
